recipe.title: Sweet Potato Cranberry Protein Muffins
recipe.summary: Moist fall protein muffins with sweet potato, lower-sugar dried cranberries, chia, and warm spices.
recipe.story: A freezer-friendly busy-morning breakfast that tastes like a real fall muffin while delivering serious protein and fiber.
ingredients: 3/4 cup cooked and mashed sweet potato
1 cup Chobani Nonfat Plain Greek Yogurt
4 scoops Clean Simple Eats Simply Vanilla Protein Powder
1/4 cup Ocean Spray Craisins 50% Less Sugar Dried Cranberries

ingredient_sections.title: Ingredients
items: 3/4 cup cooked and mashed sweet potato
1 cup Chobani Nonfat Plain Greek Yogurt
4 scoops Clean Simple Eats Simply Vanilla Protein Powder
1/4 cup Ocean Spray Craisins 50% Less Sugar Dried Cranberries

instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Lightly spray a 12-cup muffin pan with nonstick cooking spray and set aside.
Add the mashed sweet potato, Greek yogurt, egg whites, eggs, almond butter, and almond milk to a large mixing bowl. Whisk until smooth.
Add the protein powder, oat flour, almond flour, stevia brown sugar, chia seeds, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, pumpkin pie spice, and salt. Stir until evenly combined.
Fold the Craisins into the batter.
Let the finished batter rest for 5 minutes so the chia can hydrate.
Divide the batter evenly among all 12 muffin cups.
Bake for 18 to 22 minutes, until the tops spring back and a toothpick comes out with a few moist crumbs but no wet batter.
Cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack. Divide into six servings of two muffins.
freezer_storage: Cool the muffins completely and group them into servings of two.
If four servings remain, place all eight muffins in a gallon-size freezer bag. If fewer than four servings remain, use a quart-size freezer bag.
Place a small piece of parchment paper between each two-muffin serving.
Remove as much air as possible without crushing the muffins, seal, and freeze flat for up to 3 months.
reheating_instructions: Thaw one two-muffin serving overnight in the refrigerator.
Microwave both muffins for 15 to 20 seconds, or until warmed to your preference.

optional_sections.title: Optional Protein Coffee Pairing
optional_sections.intro: Pair two muffins with a protein coffee for an indulgent fall breakfast.
items: 1 scoop Clean Simple Eats Snickerdoodle Protein Powder
8 to 12 ounces black coffee of choice
optional_sections.macros: Protein Coffee Macros: 100 calories | 20g protein | 2g carbohydrates | 1g sugar | 0g fiber | 1g fat

tips: Do not add avocado oil; chia and almond milk provide moisture and fiber.
Resting the batter for 5 minutes prevents the chia from absorbing moisture during baking.
